apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: Middleware
metadata:
  name: adguard-home-cors
  namespace: apps-adguard-home
spec:
  headers:
    accessControlAllowOriginList:
      - https://homer.rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
      - https://homer.rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
    accessControlAllowMethods:
      - GET
      - OPTIONS
    accessControlAllowHeaders:
      - Authorization
      - Content-Type
    accessControlMaxAge: 600
    addVaryHeader: true
---
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: adguard-home-tailscale-cors
  namespace: apps-adguard-home
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - websecure
  routes:
    - kind: Rule
      match: Host(`adguard-home.rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl`)
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - name: adguard-home-cors
      services:
        - name: adguard-home
          port: main
  tls:
    secretName: adguard-home-tls-0
---
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: adguard-home-localdomain-cors
  namespace: apps-adguard-home
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - websecure
  routes:
    - kind: Rule
      match: Host(`adguard-home.rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl`)
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - name: adguard-home-cors
      services:
        - name: adguard-home
          port: main
  tls:
    secretName: adguard-home-tls-1
resources.name: adguard-home-cors.yaml

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: pve-api
  namespace: pve-proxy
spec:
  ports:
    - name: https
      port: 8006
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: discovery.k8s.io/v1
kind: EndpointSlice
metadata:
  name: pve-api-ipv4
  namespace: pve-proxy
  labels:
    kubernetes.io/service-name: pve-api
addressType: IPv4
ports:
  - name: https
    protocol: TCP
    port: 8006
endpoints:
  - addresses:
      - 10.0.0.72
    # Match Kubernetes' stored default so Fleet does not report endpoint drift.
    conditions: {}
---
# PVE serves its own certificate on 8006.  Traefik terminates the public TLS
# connection and deliberately does not validate that private backend cert.
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: ServersTransport
metadata:
  name: pve-backend
  namespace: pve-proxy
spec:
  insecureSkipVerify: true
---
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: Middleware
metadata:
  name: pve-api-cors
  namespace: pve-proxy
spec:
  headers:
    accessControlAllowOriginList:
      - https://homer.rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
      - https://homer.rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
    accessControlAllowMethods:
      - GET
      - OPTIONS
    accessControlAllowHeaders:
      - Authorization
      - Content-Type
    accessControlMaxAge: 600
    addVaryHeader: true
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: pve-ui
  namespace: pve-proxy
spec:
  secretName: pve-ui-tls
  issuerRef:
    kind: ClusterIssuer
    name: letsencrypt
  dnsNames:
    - proxmox2-old.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
    - proxmox2-old.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
---
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: pve-ui
  namespace: pve-proxy
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - websecure
  routes:
    - kind: Rule
      match: (Host(`proxmox2-old.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl`) || Host(`proxmox2-old.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl`)) && PathPrefix(`/api2/`)
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - name: pve-api-cors
      services:
        - name: pve-api
          port: 8006
          scheme: https
          serversTransport: pve-backend
    - kind: Rule
      match: Host(`proxmox2-old.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl`) || Host(`proxmox2-old.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl`)
      services:
        - name: pve-api
          port: 8006
          scheme: https
          serversTransport: pve-backend
  tls:
    secretName: pve-ui-tls
resources.name: pve-proxy.yaml
